ctx.x: If you didn't do things a certain way--there were certain things that Benny wouldn't accept. He didn't say don't do it, but he simply wouldn't play

it. So why knock yourself out on something that he's not going to use. I remember why I left Benny. I left Benny because I couldn't hear anymore. I couldn't hear G or C. In order to do what I was doing, there was just too much repeti- tion and I needed stimulation of another sort at that time.
